[[File:Plastent-SW1977-55.jpg|thumb|300px|Plastents on [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]].]]A '''plastent''' was a thin, portable pre-fabricated utility tent constructed of acrylic polymers that could be used as a temporary sleeping quarters for military personnel stationed on a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface. Fully inflated, a plastent stood at approximately two meters in height and could be furnished with meager survey equipment such as a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array and other small attachments. They often came with a inflation unit that allowed them to be fully inflated in a few minutes.<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] led a scouting expedition to the planet, [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]], in the hopes of finding a new, permanent base of operations for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Her [[Rebel survey team|survey team]] set up a small camp in the forests of Arbra and slept in plastents at night.
